description: This file defines a utility enum 'ExecShellWrapperParser' in Swift for parsing shell command wrappers across different shell environments (e.g., POSIX shells, Windows cmd, PowerShell). It provides methods to detect if a command line is wrapped by a shell and to extract the actual command payload, supporting nested wrappers and various shell-specific flags.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to parse and identify shell command wrappers.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Main method to extract and determine if a command is wrapped by a shell, returning a ParsedShellWrapper.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Internal method that identifies the payload of the wrapper based on shell type.

methods.name: extractPosixInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline command for POSIX shell wrappers based on recognized flags.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline command for Windows cmd shells using /c flag.

methods.name: extractPowerShellInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline command for PowerShell wrappers based on known flags.
